intro: The education system, grants and marks, and what goes on in a student's head.
p.beca.consejo: You «solicitas» it and it is «concedida» or «denegada». The one who gets it is «becario».
p.expediente.consejo: It gathers all the marks of your studies. You say «un buen expediente».
p.asignatura pendiente.consejo: In life, «mi asignatura pendiente» is something important you have not done yet.
p.optativo.consejo: The opposite is «obligatorio». For the subject you say «una optativa».
p.obligatorio.consejo: It ends in an unstressed «-io»: «o-bli-ga-TO-ryo». The opposite is «optativo».
p.presencial.consejo: It comes from «presencia». The opposite is «a distancia» or «en línea».
p.a distancia.consejo: You study «a distancia» from home, online or with materials sent to you.
p.tesis.consejo: It is the same in singular and plural: «una tesis», «dos tesis». It is feminine.
p.sobresaliente.consejo: It comes from «sobresalir», to stand out. You «sacas» a sobresaliente.
p.suspenso.consejo: You say «sacar un suspenso» or «suspender». The opposite is «aprobar».
p.memorizar.consejo: It comes from «memoria». Memorising helps, but does not replace understanding.
p.deducir.consejo: It is irregular: «deduzco», «deduces». It is conjugated like «conducir» and «traducir».
p.quedarse en blanco.consejo: It is an idiom: «me quedé en blanco» when the mind empties.
p.presentarse a.consejo: It takes «a»: «presentarse al examen». With «de» you say «examinarse de matemáticas».
b1.texto:
**The stages.** Primary, secondary and sixth form; then **la universidad** or **la formación profesional**.

**Subjects.** They can be **obligatorias** or **optativas**. If you fail one, you have **una asignatura pendiente**. It is also said in life: «learning to swim is **mi asignatura pendiente**».

**Marks.** Out of ten: **suspenso** (below five), aprobado, notable and **sobresaliente** (nine or ten). All your marks make up **el expediente**.

**Exams.** **Presentarse a** an exam, aprobar, suspender, repetir curso.

**Money.** You apply for a **beca** and they grant it or deny it.

**Formats.** A course can be **presencial** or **a distancia**.

**In your head.** **Memorizar**, **deducir**, **sacar conclusiones** and, sometimes, **quedarse en blanco**.

**False friend.** **La carrera** is a university degree, not a running race.
b2.f0.texto: How did your oral exam go?
b2.f1.texto: My mind went blank in front of the panel.
b2.f2.texto: But you knew the subject by heart.
b2.f3.texto: Memorising is not enough to pass.
b2.f4.texto: You can sit the September exam session.
b2.f5.texto: If I get a top mark, I will apply for a grant.
b2.f6.texto: With that record they will give it to you without any problem.
b2.f7.texto: A fail is not the end of your degree.
b4.texto:
Many verbs in the world of study take a fixed preposition. They should be learnt together:

- **Presentarse a** an exam: **me presento al examen**.
- **Examinarse de** a subject: **se examina de matemáticas**.
- **Licenciarse en** a degree: **se licenció en Derecho**.
- **Contar con** something: **cuento con una beca**.
- **Aprender a** + infinitive: **aprendió a mirar los cuadros**.
- **Dejar de** + infinitive: **dejó de repetir fechas**.

If you change the preposition, the sentence sounds wrong or changes meaning.
b4.e0.texto: I am sitting the exam in June.
b4.e1.texto: She has her maths exam on Monday.
b4.e2.texto: I am counting on a grant for next year.
b5.f0.texto: In the corridor of the faculty, the air weighs like a wet blanket.
b5.f1.texto: Carmela goes over her notes with tight lips and cold hands.
b5.f2.texto: When the panel says her name, the dates fly out of her head like frightened birds.
b5.f3.texto: In front of the teachers she finds a white, long silence.
b5.f4.texto: She says she remembers nothing and leaves the room with moist eyes.
b5.f5.texto: That summer she walks through the museums without notes and with an empty notebook.
b5.f6.texto: She stands still in front of each painting until the colours begin to speak to her.
b5.f7.texto: Little by little she works out the period of each work from the light and the shape of the hands.
b5.f8.texto: In September she sits the exam again with a calm mind.
b5.f9.texto: This time she speaks for twenty minutes and passes with a good mark.
b6.o0.refuerzo: A suspenso is the lowest mark, below five.
b6.o1.refuerzo: Yes: a sobresaliente is a nine or a ten.
b6.o2.refuerzo: La matrícula is money, not a mark.
b7.o1.refuerzo: The preposition is missing: the verb needs «a».
b7.o2.refuerzo: No: with this verb you use «a», not «en».
b7.pregunta: What does «presentarse» take with an exam?
b8.frase: Me quedé en blanco delante del profesor
b8.traduccion: My mind went blank in front of the teacher
b9.o0.refuerzo: No: in this case nobody is running.
b9.o1.refuerzo: That would be «la profesión»; la carrera is the studies.
b9.o2.refuerzo: Yes: «la carrera» is the university degree you study.
b9.pregunta: What does «la carrera de Medicina» mean?
b11.frase: Puedes ____ la época mirando el cuadro.
b11.o0.refuerzo: Yes: deducir is reaching an idea from clues.
b11.o1.refuerzo: Memorizar is learning by heart; here you have to think.
b11.o2.refuerzo: Suspender is getting a bad mark in an exam.
b11.pregunta: Which verb is reaching an idea by thinking?
b12.o0.refuerzo: Presencial is the opposite: you have to be in the classroom.
b12.o1.refuerzo: Yes: «a distancia» is studying without being in the same place.
b12.o2.refuerzo: Optativo means it can be chosen, not where you study.
b12.pregunta: You study from home, without going to class. What kind of course is it?
p.oral.consejo: «oral» is the same for masculine and feminine. The stress is on «RAL».
p.tribunal.consejo: «tribunal» is masculine. In exams it means the panel of examiners.
p.sabías.consejo: «saber» means to know. The «ía» ending of the past is stressed on «BI»: sa-BI-as.
p.presentarte.glosa: to sit, to present yourself (infinitive with «te»)
p.presentarte.consejo: «presentarte» = «presentar» + «te». In exams, «presentarse» means to sit the exam.
p.convocatoria.consejo: «convocatoria» is feminine: «la convocatoria». The «v» is pronounced «b».
p.saco.consejo: «sacar un sobresaliente» means to get a top mark. «saco» is the first person of «sacar».
p.pediré.consejo: «pedir» means to ask for. The future accent falls on the last syllable: pe-di-RE.
p.presento.consejo: «me presento a un examen» means I sit an exam. The stress falls on «SEN».
p.examina.consejo: «examinarse de» is to take an exam in a subject. The «x» sounds «ks».
p.matemáticas.consejo: «matemáticas» is feminine plural. It always has the accent on «MA».
p.facultad.consejo: «facultad» is feminine: «la facultad». The stress is on the final «TAD».
p.labios.consejo: «labio» is masculine: «el labio». The plural «labios» has the stress on «LA».
p.fechas.consejo: «fecha» is feminine: «la fecha». The «ch» sounds as in «church».
p.escapan.consejo: «escapar» means to escape. The «c» before «a» sounds «k»: es-KA-pan.
p.asustados.consejo: «asustado» means frightened. It agrees with «pájaros», masculine plural.
p.profesores.consejo: «profesor» is masculine: «el profesor». The plural adds «-es».
p.museos.consejo: «museo» is masculine: «el museo». The «eo» is two syllables.
p.deduce.consejo: «deducir» means to work something out by reasoning. The «c» sounds «th».
p.presentarse.consejo: With «se», «presentarse» means to sit an exam. The stress is on «TAR».
p.aprueba.consejo: «aprobar» means to pass. The «ue» is a single sound: a-PRWE-ba.
p.notable.consejo: «un notable» is a grade between seven and nine. It is masculine.
p.quedé.consejo: «quedarse en blanco» means to go blank. The accent marks the final stress: ke-DE.
p.universitarios.consejo: «universitario» means related to university. The «v» sounds «b».
p.mirando.consejo: «mirando» is the gerund of «mirar». It is used for an action happening now.
p.hablarle.consejo: «le» attaches to «hablar»: «hablarle» means to speak to someone.
